1. Which element has atomic number 74? A: tantalum B: tungsten C: rhenium D: osmium
2. In which year was the Treaty of Westphalia signed? A: 1618 B: 1648 C: 1658 D: 1688
3. Which city is the capital of Kazakhstan? A: Almaty B: Astana C: Shymkent D: Karaganda
4. Who wrote 'The Master and Margarita'? A: Bulgakov B: Gogol C: Pasternak D: Nabokov
5. Which planet has the longest day? A: Mercury B: Venus C: Mars D: Neptune
6. Which river flows through Budapest? A: Elbe B: Vistula C: Danube D: Dniester
7. Who proved the Poincaré conjecture? A: Wiles B: Tao C: Perelman D: Thurston
8. Which gas is most abundant in the atmosphere of Mars? A: nitrogen B: argon C: methane D: carbon dioxide
9. In which year did the Byzantine Empire fall? A: 1389 B: 1453 C: 1492 D: 1517
10. Which composer wrote 'The Rite of Spring'? A: Prokofiev B: Ravel C: Stravinsky D: Bartok
11. What is the smallest prime greater than 100? A: 101 B: 103 C: 107 D: 109
12. Which country has the longest coastline? A: Russia B: Indonesia C: Canada D: Norway
13. Who painted 'The Garden of Earthly Delights'? A: Bruegel B: Bosch C: Durer D: van Eyck
14. What is the SI unit of magnetic flux? A: tesla B: henry C: weber D: gauss
15. Which philosopher wrote 'Being and Time'? A: Husserl B: Sartre C: Heidegger D: Jaspers
16. What is the derivative of arctan(x) at x = 1? A: 1 B: 1/2 C: 1/4 D: 2
17. Which country first gave women the vote nationally? A: Finland B: New Zealand C: Norway D: Australia
18. Which particle carries the strong force? A: photon B: gluon C: W boson D: graviton

10. Request: Order a car to the train station. Tools: uber_request, lyft_request, bolt_request
11. Request: Play some quiet piano music. Tools: spotify_play, apple_music_play, youtube_music_play
12. Request: Save a note that says: buy milk. Tools: evernote_save, notion_save, onenote_save
